rows.notes: The cited document is a narrative review (title and abstract: 'A comprehensive review on smart and sustainable agriculture using IoT technologies'; Section 1.1 objectives are to overview, analyse and identify challenges). It reports no data, experiment, survey or model runs of its own. Statements about drones reducing wastage and environmental damage (Section 7.7) and about precision farming reducing fertilizer/chemical use (Section 7.2) are synthesised from other works and are not the authors' own results. Nothing in the review specifically addresses soil degradation reduction as an own finding.
